Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: InfinityBuilds A (Akiha, 'S15 Summon Necromancer, From Leveling to Torment XII Speed Farm', updated 2026-09-15) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll B endgame and B push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; d4builds has no minion placement - its Golem C page is a Desecration Golem build with Leoric's Crown and Mace of King Leoric, a different build [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: InfinityBuilds A vs Maxroll B. Third in the class under the owner's tie-break (d4builds tier, then d4builds in-tier order, then InfinityBuilds, then Maxroll): d4builds places no minion build, and its C for Bone Spirit outranks no placement, so the Bone Spirit theorycraft sits second. The disagreement stays visible: InfinityBuilds (weight 2) ranks Minions A while Bone Spirit is unranked there, and Maxroll puts Bone Spirit A above Minion B. Construction: InfinityBuilds variants 'Starter 1-70', 'Beginner T1-T10' and 'AFK Shadow Full Package' for leveling through late endgame (weighted over Maxroll for the stages both cover) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/s15-xii-necromancer-A14vDXgQb4 - 2026-09-16]; pushing uses Maxroll planner iz19bx0q 'Mages', because neither source labels a minion push variant and 'Mages' is Maxroll's fullest mythic profile [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/iz19bx0q - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll's planner changelog is Season 14 text, but the planner (saved 2026-09-15) carries Season 15 Soul Splinters. InfinityBuilds-vs-Maxroll disagreements kept: InfinityBuilds charm The Furnace vs Maxroll Bloodless Scream / Red Blessing / Waking Touch charms; InfinityBuilds Stone of Jordan ring vs Maxroll legendary Hellbent Commander ring; InfinityBuilds Army of the Dead 15 vs Maxroll Army of the Dead 1 in Mages. 3.2.1 facts: Army of the Dead recast stacks up to 5 times; Unyielding Commander 'your Minions take 90% reduced damage and deal 30% increased damage'; Rathma's Waking Touch 2-piece 60%[x] / 5-piece 200%[x] Summoning damage; Peace of the Black Shroud 2-piece 30s to 10s; core stat 1.625 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll warns 'There is a bug currently that is scaling the amount of extra minions [from The Undercrown] based on the damage portion' (Warrior profile notes) - re-verify. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Minions do the work: keep Army of the Dead's passive active, command Skeleton Warriors onto targets, Golem's active for Unstoppable and Ferocity, Sever (mapping) or Blood Mist (bosses) to move.
  2. Hold 100% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance.
Variants

Leveling — Summon and command; Army of the Dead on cooldown; Golem active for Unstoppable; Sever to move. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when At Torment 1 with The Undercrown, Blood Moon Breeches and Pact of Bone in hand, switch to the Beginner kit.

Early Endgame — Command Skeleton Warriors onto the target; Golem active every few seconds; Army of the Dead on cooldown; Blood Mist to escape; Sever to move. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Swap to the full package when Blood Moon Breeches, The Undercrown, The Hand of Naz and Pact of Bone are all Mythic and Stone of Jordan drops.

Late Endgame — AFK: Army of the Dead on cooldown for its passive; command Skeleton Warriors; Golem active for Unstoppable; Blood Mist to escape, Sever to reposition. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to the Maxroll push kit when you own Seal of the Diamond Mind (to run 4-piece Rathma's Waking Touch + 2-piece Black Shroud) and Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire.

Pushing — Blight to group and chill; The Undercrown lets the command also direct Shadow Mages; Golem active for Unstoppable and Ferocity; Blood Mist when bossing/pushing, Sever when mapping. [Maxroll iz19bx0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage - upgrade splinters to Abyssal and complete the Waking Touch charms.

Stat requirements
  • Maxroll: 100% Attack Speed is the number one priority (Cult Leader multiplier)
  • Maxroll: 100% Critical Strike Chance
  • Maxroll: 30k Maximum Life
  • InfinityBuilds (Akiha): reach 100 Attack Speed to fully benefit from Cult Leader

Hellfire caveat (the −100% Critical Strike Chance drawback is first-party since 2026-09-20; how the reference's crit floor survives it is unresolved): Splinter of Hellfire trades its damage for −100% Critical Strike Chance [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24292852/the-3-2-0-ptr-what-you-need-to-know - 2026-09-13]; the live 3.2.1 feed carries the same drawback (knowledge/current-season.md, Soul Splinters, 2026-09-16) and the shipped game confirms it (attribute description S15_Socketable_NaKrul, gamedata/install/attributes.json SNO 4080, script formula SF_1 = 1 in gamedata/install/script_formulas.json; local install 3.2.1.73552 - 2026-09-20; the per-tier damage bonus stays a feed value, unconfirmed), yet Maxroll's 'Mages' profile (iz19bx0q) pairs it with Splinter of Anguish and its own '100% Critical Strike Chance' minimum as published; this site keeps the gear as the reference publishes it. Follow the reference, then check the character sheet with Hellfire socketed: if Critical Strike Chance reads 0%, treat the Critical Strike Chance floor, every Critical Strike Chance affix and temper and Splinter of Anguish's crit line as dead, and test Splinter of Anguish or Pain in Hellfire's place on a dummy - the reference's crit floor against the drawback is unresolved, re-verify in game.

How to run them

InfinityBuilds (Akiha): Subo with Raheir's Bastion reinforcement; the opportunity trigger is from its Beginner variant ('on Skill Cast'), the AFK variant leaves it blank. Maxroll's Mages profile also hires Subo (Ambusher, Scorched Earth, Snipe, Molotov - 'map hack and a small amount of damage') but reinforces with Aldkin's Field of Languish ('a boost to your damage reduction'); its Mid Game profile hires Varyana.

Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: InfinityBuilds A (Akiha, 'S15 Summon Necromancer, From Leveling to Torment XII Speed Farm', updated 2026-09-15) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll B endgame and B push [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]; d4builds has no minion placement - its Golem C page is a Desecration Golem build with Leoric's Crown and Mace of King Leoric, a different build [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]. Disagreement kept visible: InfinityBuilds A vs Maxroll B. Third in the class under the owner's tie-break (d4builds tier, then d4builds in-tier order, then InfinityBuilds, then Maxroll): d4builds places no minion build, and its C for Bone Spirit outranks no placement, so the Bone Spirit theorycraft sits second. The disagreement stays visible: InfinityBuilds (weight 2) ranks Minions A while Bone Spirit is unranked there, and Maxroll puts Bone Spirit A above Minion B. Construction: InfinityBuilds variants 'Starter 1-70', 'Beginner T1-T10' and 'AFK Shadow Full Package' for leveling through late endgame (weighted over Maxroll for the stages both cover) [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/s15-xii-necromancer-A14vDXgQb4 - 2026-09-16]; pushing uses Maxroll planner iz19bx0q 'Mages', because neither source labels a minion push variant and 'Mages' is Maxroll's fullest mythic profile [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/iz19bx0q - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll's planner changelog is Season 14 text, but the planner (saved 2026-09-15) carries Season 15 Soul Splinters. InfinityBuilds-vs-Maxroll disagreements kept: InfinityBuilds charm The Furnace vs Maxroll Bloodless Scream / Red Blessing / Waking Touch charms; InfinityBuilds Stone of Jordan ring vs Maxroll legendary Hellbent Commander ring; InfinityBuilds Army of the Dead 15 vs Maxroll Army of the Dead 1 in Mages. 3.2.1 facts: Army of the Dead recast stacks up to 5 times; Unyielding Commander 'your Minions take 90% reduced damage and deal 30% increased damage'; Rathma's Waking Touch 2-piece 60%[x] / 5-piece 200%[x] Summoning damage; Peace of the Black Shroud 2-piece 30s to 10s; core stat 1.625 [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll warns 'There is a bug currently that is scaling the amount of extra minions [from The Undercrown] based on the damage portion' (Warrior profile notes) - re-verify. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Minions do the work: keep Army of the Dead's passive active, command Skeleton Warriors onto targets, Golem's active for Unstoppable and Ferocity, Sever (mapping) or Blood Mist (bosses) to move.
  2. Hold 100% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance.
Variants

Leveling — Summon and command; Army of the Dead on cooldown; Golem active for Unstoppable; Sever to move. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when At Torment 1 with The Undercrown, Blood Moon Breeches and Pact of Bone in hand, switch to the Beginner kit.

Early Endgame — Command Skeleton Warriors onto the target; Golem active every few seconds; Army of the Dead on cooldown; Blood Mist to escape; Sever to move. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Swap to the full package when Blood Moon Breeches, The Undercrown, The Hand of Naz and Pact of Bone are all Mythic and Stone of Jordan drops.

Late Endgame — AFK: Army of the Dead on cooldown for its passive; command Skeleton Warriors; Golem active for Unstoppable; Blood Mist to escape, Sever to reposition. [InfinityBuilds, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to the Maxroll push kit when you own Seal of the Diamond Mind (to run 4-piece Rathma's Waking Touch + 2-piece Black Shroud) and Abyssal Splinter of Hellfire.

Pushing — Blight to group and chill; The Undercrown lets the command also direct Shadow Mages; Golem active for Unstoppable and Ferocity; Blood Mist when bossing/pushing, Sever when mapping. [Maxroll iz19bx0q notes, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage - upgrade splinters to Abyssal and complete the Waking Touch charms.

Stat requirements
  • Maxroll: 100% Attack Speed is the number one priority (Cult Leader multiplier)
  • Maxroll: 100% Critical Strike Chance
  • Maxroll: 30k Maximum Life
  • InfinityBuilds (Akiha): reach 100 Attack Speed to fully benefit from Cult Leader

Reasoning

Based onBlood Wave Necromancer
Tweaks vs. the base build
  1. Swap the damage engine from Blood Wave to minions: Army of the Dead, Skeleton Mage and Skeleton Warrior at 15 ranks each and Golem at 13 (InfinityBuilds 'AFK Shadow Full Package') - InfinityBuilds ranks Minions A beside Bloodwave, and its guide is titled 'From Leveling to Torment XII Speed Farm'.
  2. Book of the Dead: Shadow Skeletal Mages (upgrade B), Reaper Warriors (upgrade B), Iron Golem (upgrade A) - the Darkness-minion package both InfinityBuilds and Maxroll use.
  3. Leoric's Crown -> The Undercrown (Mythic): extra warriors and mages. The only Season 15 reference family that does not wear Leoric's Crown.
  4. Kessime's Legacy -> Blood Moon Breeches (Mythic): 'your Curse delivery system' - minions apply both curses (Maxroll notes), so Decrepify is allocated but not barred.
  5. Weapon + shield -> Bloodless Scream (two-handed scythe, Mythic): Darkness skill ranks; Maxroll's Mages profile makes it mythic priority #1.
  6. Gloves Fists of Fate -> The Hand of Naz (Mythic): one more mage and an area hit.
  7. Rings: Ring of Starless Skies / Tides of Blood -> Pact of Bone (Mythic) + Stone of Jordan (Mythic): Pact of Bone supplies ~45% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance toward the 100%/100% caps (InfinityBuilds notes).
  8. Talisman: Word of the Blood Binder -> Peace of the Black Shroud 5-piece + The Furnace charm - all minion skills here are Darkness skills (Maxroll notes). 3.2.1 cut the Black Shroud 2-piece duration 30s -> 10s.
  9. Paragon: Bloodbath/Scent of Death/Frailty/Flesh-eater -> Cult Leader [Deadraiser], Wither [Abyssal], Frailty [Warrior], Scent of Death [Mage] on a Start [Essence] board - Cult Leader scales with Attack Speed, hence the 100% target.
  10. Bar loses every Blood skill: Army of the Dead, Sever, Blood Mist, Golem, Skeleton Mage, Skeleton Warrior - near button-free play; Golem's active is the Unstoppable source.

The Undercrown

Unique Helm

  • Your maximum number of Skeleton Warriors and Skeleton Mages is increased by 4 and your Summon damage is increased by 15.0 – 25.0%.
  • Commanding Skeleton Warriors also causes Skeleton Mages to focus the same target for 5 seconds.

"There is no true death. There is only the movement from one world to another. I stand in both of these worlds." -Necromancer Zayl

Necromancer

Dropped By:Duriel, King of Maggots

Blood Moon Breeches

Unique Pants

  • Your Summons have a 7.0 – 10.0% chance to randomly inflict Decrepify or Iron Maiden when they deal damage.
  • You deal 50 – 60% increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies affected by your Curses.

A naturally occurring curiosity, the blood moon persists as a sign of woe for the most superstitious Zakarum faithful. Children born under it are often considered cursed and cast out, lest it spread.

Necromancer

Dropped By:Astaroth

Bloodless Scream

Unique Two-Handed Scythe

  • Your Darkness Skills Chill enemies for up to 100% and deal 100 – 125% increased damage to Frozen enemies and bosses.
  • Every 800 times you damage enemies with Darkness Skills, all Nearby enemies are Feared for 0.25 seconds before Freezing for 3 more seconds.

"My companion swung her odd weapon in a wide arc, and our pursuer stopped short. The look of horror on his face as his body fell to pieces will haunt me forever." -The Ebon Pages, Canto II, Verse XI

Necromancer

Dropped By:Astaroth

The Hand of Naz

Unique Gloves

  • Your maximum number of Skeleton Mages is increased by 1 and they are upgraded to Arch-Mages.
  • Arch-Mages teleport to safety when attacked and their attacks occasionally shatter on impact, dealing 80 – 90% increased damage to the enemy and up to 3 additional targets.

Legends say that the Hand of Naz was not made, but cursed into being. Woe to the living who unearth it, for the price is the same regardless of form. The cavity where a gem once lay is empty.

Necromancer

Dropped By:Echo of Varshan

Pact of Bone

Unique Ring

  • Your Minions gain +30 – 35% Attack Speed and Critical Strike Chance.
  • When one of your Minions die, your other Minions enrage, dealing 30 – 35% increased damage for 3 seconds.

"Can one befriend the dead? What loyalty is earned or granted in the act of reanimation? On this subject, there is much I have yet to understand." -Deckard Cain

Necromancer

Dropped By:Harbinger of Hatred

Stone of Jordan

Unique Ring

  • Your Resistances are each equal to your highest, and you deal 15 – 25% more damage of that Element.

Nine out of ten appraisers would see a dull stone. Crudely cut. Simply set. But a trained eye might see past the illusion placed by its Ammuit craftsman...and marvel at the wellspring of magic within.

UpgradeBlight

Blight has an additional 20%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

Volatile Blood

UpgradeBlight

Blight becomes a Blood skill that deals Physical damage.

Blight's defiled area instantly bursts, dealing 315% damage.

Piercing Darkness

UpgradeBlight

Blight pierces 1 time and can spawn an additional defiled area. Blight deals 75%[x] increased damage to Bosses.

Size Bonus

UpgradeBlight

Blight's Size is increased by 35%.

Area Damage Bonus

UpgradeBlight

Blight's defiled area deals 40%[x] increased damage.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeSever

Sever deals 10%[x] increased damage, and an additional 1%[x] increased damage for each Minion you have.

Reaping Lotus

UpgradeSever

Sever sends out 3 additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing 60% damage each.

Cold Pursuit

UpgradeSever

Sever deals Cold damage, Chills for 15%, and seeks another enemy to attack again.

Ferocity

UpgradeSever

Sever deals 7%[x] increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

Movement Speed

UpgradeBlood Mist

Blood Mist increases your Movement Speed by 30%[x] for 3 seconds.

Blood Rush

UpgradeBlood Mist

Blood Mist is now also a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds.

Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for 3.0 seconds.

Devouring Mist

UpgradeBlood Mist

Blood Mist becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Blood Mist now deals 600% Shadow damage over its duration and applies Vampiric Curse to enemies.

Overpower

UpgradeBlood Mist

Blood Mist grants 1 stack of Overpower every second.

Bone Prison

MacabreBone

Cooldown: 15 seconds

Unearth a prison of bone with {x} Life that surrounds the target area for 6 seconds.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeBone Prison

Bone Prison reduces your active Cooldowns by 0.5 seconds for each enemy trapped, up to 5 seconds.

Essence Generation

UpgradeBone Prison

Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.

Bramble

UpgradeBone Prison

You gain {x} Thorns for each enemy trapped by Bone Prison.

When a segment of Bone Prison is destroyed or expires, it deals 100% of your Thorns around itself.

Plunging Darkness

UpgradeBone Prison

Bone Prison becomes a Darkness Skill.

Bone Prison forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of Desecrated Ground, dealing 450% Corrupting damage.

Life Imprisonment

UpgradeBone Prison

Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you.

While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by 20%, but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.

Vulnerable

UpgradeBone Prison

Bone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

Resolve

UpgradeBone Prison

Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.

Vulnerable

UpgradeIron Maiden

Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden are Vulnerable.

Torture Artist

UpgradeIron Maiden

Iron Maiden is also a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Enemies have 30% chance to be stunned for 2 seconds when they take damage from Iron Maiden.

Schadenfreude

UpgradeIron Maiden

While at least 1 enemy is afflicted with Iron Maiden, you gain {x} Thorns.

Iron Maiden's damage is increased by 100% of your Thorns.

Essence Generation

UpgradeIron Maiden

Iron Maiden no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates 5 Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with Iron Maiden.

Movement Speed

UpgradeDecrepify

Each enemy afflicted with Decrepify increases your Movement Speed by 2%[x].

Unholy Frenzy

UpgradeDecrepify

Instead of afflicting enemies Decrepify is now applied to your Minions, granting them 20% increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.

Life Tap

UpgradeDecrepify

Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for 10.0% of your Maximum Life ({x}) whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second.

Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.

Cooldown Reduction

UpgradeDecrepify

Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.

Critical Strike Chance

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

You gain an additional 5%[+] increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.

Essence Generation

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Casting Corpse Tendrils generates 35 Essence.

Bitter Harvest

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Corpse Tendrils no longer consumes the Corpse. Enemies are Immobilized for 3 seconds after being Pulled in.

Get Over Here!

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Corpse Tendrils is no longer cast on a Corpse and is cast on you instead.

Corpse Tendrils Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life ({x}) for each enemy it damages.

Jaws Of Death

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Corpse Tendrils now deals 100% damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.

Vulnerable

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

Lucky Hit Chance

UpgradeCorpse Tendrils

Corpse Tendrils gains an additional 40%[+] Lucky Hit Chance.

UpgradeBlood Wave

Casting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.

Blood Orb

UpgradeBlood Wave

Blood Wave forms up to 2 Blood Orbs as it travels.

Hematolagnia

UpgradeBlood Wave

Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 70 Essence.

Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300% damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.

Path of Darkness

UpgradeBlood Wave

Blood Wave becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage.

Blood Wave leaves behind a trail of Desecrated Ground as it travels that deals 800% Corrupting damage.

Tides of Blood

UpgradeBlood Wave

Blood Wave launches 1 additional wave, dealing 500% damage.

Damage Reduction

UpgradeBlood Wave

Casting Blood Wave grants 10% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.

Damage Bonus

UpgradeBlood Wave

Blood Wave deals 30%[x] increased damage while you are Fortified.

Movement Speed

UpgradeSoulrift

While Soulrift is active you are Unhindered and gain 1%[+] increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to 40%[+].

This bonus persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

Barrier

UpgradeSoulrift

Every soul absorbed by Soulrift grants a Barrier for 0.5% of your Maximum Life ({x}).

This Barrier persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.

Distilled Anima

UpgradeSoulrift

While Soulrift is active, your Darkness damage is increased by 30%.

Soul Vortex

UpgradeSoulrift

Soulrift is cast at the target location and its Cooldown is reduced by 15 seconds. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals 25% damage and Pulls them in.

Frozen Wasteland

UpgradeSoulrift

Soulrift deals Frostbite damage and Chills for 30% every second.

If Soulrift absorbs the soul of a Frozen enemy, they shatter and explode for 75% damage.

Vulnerable and Crowd Control

UpgradeSoulrift

When Soulrift absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

After Soulrift ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by 85% for 5 seconds.

Ferocity

UpgradeSoulrift

Every 30 souls absorbed by Soulrift grants 1 stack of Ferocity.

Roll The Bones

Hungry Cyclone

UpgradeBone Storm

Vulnerable

UpgradeBone Storm

Barrier

UpgradeBone Storm

Pile the Bodies
